description: ANCHORAGE, AK – Today, an initial group of respected Alaska Native leaders announced their endorsement of U.S. Senator Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska) for re-election in 2026.“I’m incredibly grateful for the continued trust and support of these respected Alaskan leaders, who care deeply about Alaska’s future,” said Senator Dan Sullivan. “Working together, we’ve made real progress and positioned our […]

title: Alaska Native Leaders Endorse Senator Dan Sullivan’s Re-Election - Dan Sullivan for Alaska
